items.defectStatement: Making .contents a flex container leaves the header-extra-info component's outer div with min-width:auto. Its inner overflow constraint cannot make that flex item shrink, so long non-wrapping topic titles push the navigation panel outside the header instead of truncating.
obligations: Allow the outer header-extra-info flex item to shrink below its content's intrinsic width.
Preserve topic-title truncation and keep the navigation panel within the header when the other header controls fit.
Preserve the flex layout, vertical centering, and existing logo and panel sizing constraints.
items.notes: The replacement can add a nested direct-child rule inside .contents. The exclusion selector uses classes visible in the frozen input and reaches the component root; applying min-width:0 only to .extra-info-wrapper would not fix the defect.
